answer: Suppose each new credential must publish a mirror of its output stream, a replayable transcript sealed by an inlet-indexed hash chain, and the ledger credits only work another credential has mirrored back with its own chain. A haven credential that mirrors nobody earns nothing, and self-mirroring is rejected since the chain index must strictly increase across distinct sources. Cloning forces each replica to consume another replica's transcript, building a dependency graph that grows with farm size and collapses when one node is pulled for inspection.
